↳ who we are

More than a shop — a design journey built through practice

Craftshan Studio is the personal creative work of M Kashian Malik, founded around a simple belief: good digital design should look clean, feel thoughtful, and be practical for the person who is going to make something with it. What began with curiosity and a willingness to learn gradually became a focused direction in laser-cut and crafting design.

The story behind Craftshan

The name Craftshan combines “Craft”, reflecting the world of crafting and making, with “Shan”, taken from Kashian’s name. It represents both sides of the journey — the love of making useful designs and the personal effort behind building a creative identity.

While he was a computer science student, Kashian was also steadily developing his design skills outside his studies. The early stage was far from ideal. He worked on a low-end laptop where even opening Adobe Illustrator could take several minutes. Instead of waiting for better equipment, he chose to work with what he had: learning the software, practising, studying references, testing ideas, and improving one design at a time.

With continuous support from his father, his setup eventually improved and gave him more room to experiment. Another important influence was his close friend Saqib Ahmed, whom he considers like an elder brother. Saqib introduced him to the foundations of design, helped him through early challenges, and encouraged him to keep developing the skill instead of treating it as a temporary hobby.

Designed for real makers

That experience shaped the way Craftshan Studio approaches digital design today. The focus is on practical laser-cut files such as ornaments, earrings, keychains, signs, layered pieces, and other maker-friendly projects. The goal is not to make a design complicated for the sake of looking impressive. The goal is to make it clear, balanced, usable, and ready for the creative process that comes after the download.

Each design begins with an idea, but the details matter just as much. Cut lines, shapes, spacing, layers, proportions, and the overall ease of use all influence whether a file is genuinely useful. Kashian believes that one of the most valuable skills in design is the ability to think of new possibilities and then turn those ideas into something people can actually make.

A studio built on consistency

Craftshan Studio is being built step by step. Seasonal demand, new crafting trends, and the needs of makers all help shape what gets designed next, while quality and usefulness remain at the centre of the work. The aim is to grow a catalog that customers can return to when they need a clean, dependable file for their next project.

There is also a strong belief in listening to customers. When something can be improved, the right response is to learn from the feedback and make it better. Long-term trust matters more than a quick sale, because a digital product store becomes meaningful when people know that the person behind it genuinely cares about the work.

Where Craftshan Studio is going

The long-term goal is simple: continue building a creative career through skill, consistency, and useful design. Craftshan Studio is not presented as a large company or a marketplace of many creators. It is one independent studio, one founder, and a growing body of work shaped by years of learning, experimentation, and a genuine interest in making better files for makers.

Every design is another step in that journey — from an early idea on a screen to a finished physical project in someone’s hands. That is what Craftshan Studio is here to support.

M Kashian Malik
Owner & Founder, Craftshan Studio · Digital Designer of LaserCut Files
↳ what drives the work

Built around a few simple principles

Practical creativity

Design should be creative, but it should also work. Every file is approached with the maker’s real workflow in mind.

Consistency over shortcuts

The journey has been built by learning, practicing, testing, and improving rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

Details matter

Clean lines, thoughtful structure, and usability are part of the design—not things to fix afterward.

↳ the road ahead

Building a career through skill

The long-term goal is to build an independent career in graphic and digital design—turning creative skill into sustainable work while continuing to grow through every project, every experiment, and every new challenge.

Craftshan Studio is built on a simple idea: start with what you have, keep learning, and keep moving forward.

↳ craftshan studio license

Make something.
Sell what you make.

Our license is designed for makers and crafters who purchase digital files from Craftshan Studio to create finished physical products. The digital design remains protected while you receive the rights described below for your own projects and eligible commercial work.

Last updated: August 21, 2026

Quick Summary

You may use a purchased design to make finished physical products. You may not sell, share, upload, redistribute, or otherwise provide the digital design file itself to other people or businesses.

✓ What You May Do

  • Download and use a design you have legitimately purchased.
  • Use the design for personal crafting and project work.
  • Where commercial use is enabled for that product, create and sell finished physical items.
  • Make unlimited physical copies of a commercially licensed design unless a product page states a different limit.
  • Resize, recolor, personalize, layer, or otherwise adjust a design as needed for the physical product you are making.
  • Use photographs or mockups of your finished physical products for your own advertising and product listings.

✕ What You May Not Do

  • Sell or give away the original digital file.
  • Share the file with customers, friends, family, contractors, designers, production partners, or other businesses.
  • Upload the file to file-sharing services, public drives, marketplaces, groups, forums, or downloadable libraries.
  • Resell a modified, converted, traced, redrawn, simplified, or otherwise changed digital version.
  • Include the digital design in another downloadable product, bundle, template, collection, membership, or subscription.
  • Claim ownership or authorship of the underlying Craftshan Studio digital design.

Physical Product Rights

For products marked as commercially licensed, the intended commercial use is the creation and sale of finished physical goods such as ornaments, signs, earrings, keychains, layered decor, gifts, and other craft products made from suitable materials.

The commercial permission applies to the finished physical item, not to the reusable digital file used to make it.

Edits Do Not Create Digital Resale Rights

You may customize a design for your physical project, including changing size, wording, names, colors, layers, or other visual details. Those changes do not transfer ownership of the original design and do not create permission to sell or distribute the resulting digital file.

Free Designs

Unless a specific free product page says otherwise, free files are intended for personal, non-commercial crafting use. Do not resell, redistribute, share, or include a free design in another digital product. Check the individual listing whenever a free file has special terms.

Ownership & Copyright

Purchasing a digital file gives you a license to use it under these terms. It does not transfer copyright or ownership of the underlying artwork. All rights not expressly granted remain with Craftshan Studio and the applicable rights holder.

Product-Specific Terms

Some products may have different or additional permissions. When a product listing provides special license terms, those product-specific terms control for that purchase. Read the product page before using a design commercially.

Questions About a Use Case?

When you are unsure whether a specific use is allowed, contact Craftshan Studio before using or distributing the design. Written permission may be required for uses outside the rights expressly granted here.

The Simple Rule

Digital design → create your physical product → sell the finished item ✓

Digital design → sell, share, upload, or redistribute the file ✕

↳ privacy & data

Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 21, 2026

Craftshan Studio respects your privacy and aims to handle personal information carefully and transparently. This policy explains what information may be collected, why it may be used, and the choices available to you when you browse the store, purchase a digital design, contact us, or use future creative tools.

1. About Craftshan Studio

Craftshan Studio is an independent digital design store operated by M Kashian Malik. The store provides laser-cut and crafting design files, related digital resources, customer support, and future creative tools.

2. Information You Choose to Provide

Depending on how you use the website, you may provide information such as:

  • Name and email address.
  • Account or profile information.
  • Order numbers and purchase details.
  • Messages sent through the contact form.
  • Support requests, screenshots, or technical details.
  • Reviews, comments, saved designs, or other content you voluntarily submit.
  • Information entered into optional creative tools when needed to provide the requested result.

You can browse most public areas without creating an account.

3. Orders and Payment Information

When online payments are enabled, a third-party payment provider may process your payment information. Craftshan Studio may receive limited transaction details needed to deliver and manage the order, such as your name, email, order number, product purchased, purchase date, payment status, and relevant billing or transaction details.

We do not intend to store complete payment-card numbers when payment details are handled directly by the payment provider. The provider may have its own terms and privacy policy.

4. Information Collected Automatically

Our website, hosting provider, security services, or analytics tools may collect technical information automatically. This can include browser and device type, operating system, approximate region, pages visited, visit time, referring page, interactions, download activity, error information, and security or server logs.

These details may help us operate, secure, troubleshoot, and improve Craftshan Studio.

5. Cookies and Similar Technologies

Craftshan Studio may use cookies or similar technologies for essential functions, account sessions, preferences, security, analytics, and optional features. Where consent is legally required for non-essential tracking, the appropriate controls should be provided before those technologies are enabled.

6. How We Use Information

Information may be used to:

  • Operate and maintain the website.
  • Create and manage customer accounts.
  • Process purchases and provide authorized digital downloads.
  • Maintain order and license records.
  • Respond to customer questions and technical support requests.
  • Investigate corrupted files, fraud, abuse, or unauthorized distribution.
  • Improve products, tools, website performance, and customer experience.
  • Maintain business, security, accounting, and legal records where reasonably necessary.
  • Send important service or transaction-related communications.

7. Digital Downloads and License Records

Purchase and download records may be retained so Craftshan Studio can confirm a valid purchase, provide authorized access to the purchased ZIP package, maintain license information, assist with support requests, investigate unauthorized sharing, resolve disputes, and maintain necessary business records.

8. Free Designs

Free downloads may involve limited technical or download information needed to deliver the file, prevent abuse, protect the website, measure usage, and protect the underlying design. A free download does not by itself mean you have agreed to marketing emails unless you separately provide that consent where required.

9. Creative and Design Tools

Future Craftshan Studio tools may allow you to enter text, names, measurements, settings, images, or other design information. Inputs may be processed only as needed to provide the tool's requested function, maintain security, diagnose problems, or improve the service.

Please avoid entering passwords, payment information, government identification, medical information, or other highly sensitive personal information into creative tools unless a specific tool clearly requires it.

10. Contact and Customer Support

When you contact us, we may keep your message and supporting information so we can respond and maintain reasonable support records. This may include your name, email, order number, screenshots, error messages, software or machine details, and anything else you choose to provide.

11. Reviews, Likes, and Customer Content

If you submit a review, save a design, or otherwise interact with customer features, the website may store information needed to associate that activity with your account and display it appropriately. Please avoid posting private information in public review areas.

12. Analytics

Craftshan Studio may use analytics tools to understand traffic, popular pages, general device and browser information, website performance, and interactions. Where applicable law requires consent for non-essential analytics, the appropriate consent controls should be used.

13. When We May Share Information

Craftshan Studio does not sell personal information as a normal part of its business. Limited information may be shared with service providers when reasonably necessary for services such as hosting, storage, payment processing, email, security, customer support, analytics, backups, or technical maintenance.

Information may also be disclosed when required by applicable law, a lawful request, fraud investigation, protection of intellectual property, enforcement of website terms, or protection of legal rights and safety.

14. Business Transfers

If Craftshan Studio or a material part of its business is reorganized, sold, transferred, or acquired, relevant business information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to applicable privacy requirements.

15. Data Retention

Information is kept only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected or for legitimate business, accounting, licensing, security, dispute, or legal reasons. Backup copies may remain for a limited period as part of normal backup operations.

16. Security

Reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures should be used to protect personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, disclosure, loss, alteration, or destruction. No website, internet transmission, or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

17. Your Privacy Choices

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights relating to your personal information, including access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, portability, or withdrawal of consent for certain processing. Some records may need to be retained for legal, accounting, licensing, security, or dispute-related purposes.

18. Marketing Messages

If Craftshan Studio introduces newsletters or promotional messages, an appropriate unsubscribe method will be provided where required. Unsubscribing from marketing will not necessarily stop important transactional communications about purchases, downloads, account security, customer support, or material service changes.

19. Third-Party Websites and Services

The website may contain links to external websites or services. Once you leave Craftshan Studio, the privacy practices of that third party apply. We are not responsible for the privacy, security, or content practices of independent third-party services.

20. Children

Craftshan Studio is intended primarily for adult makers, customers, and creators. We do not knowingly seek personal information directly from children where parental consent would be legally required. If you believe information was submitted inappropriately, please contact us.

21. Privacy Controls and Browser Signals

Some browsers and devices provide privacy controls such as cookie restrictions or privacy preference signals. Where applicable law requires a particular signal to be recognized, Craftshan Studio will make reasonable efforts to honor that requirement.

22. Changes to This Policy

This policy may be updated when the website, products, tools, service providers, privacy practices, or legal requirements change. The latest version will appear on this page with a revised update date when appropriate.

23. Related Policies

This Privacy Policy should be read together with the Craftshan Studio Terms & Conditions, Commercial License, and Refund Policy. Each document covers a different part of the customer relationship.

24. Contact Us About Privacy

If you have a privacy question, want to request access or correction, or need to raise a privacy concern, contact Craftshan Studio through the website contact page and include enough information for us to understand your request.

Privacy in Simple Terms

We aim to collect and use only the information reasonably needed to run the store, manage accounts and purchases, provide authorized downloads and support, protect digital designs, and improve the Craftshan Studio experience.

Payment details are handled by the payment provider when online payments are enabled, and you can contact us about your privacy choices or requests.

↳ refunds & support

Refund Policy

Last updated: August 21, 2026

Craftshan Studio sells digital design files delivered electronically. Because digital files cannot be physically returned after delivery, purchases are generally final, while genuine file problems are handled through support and replacement where appropriate.

1. Digital Purchases Are Generally Final

Once a digital product has been made available to you, Craftshan Studio generally does not provide refunds simply because you changed your mind, no longer need the design, or prefer a different product. Please review the product images, description, included formats, compatibility information, and license before purchasing.

2. When We May Offer a Remedy

If there is a genuine problem with a purchased design, we will first try to help you resolve it. Depending on the situation, we may provide a corrected file, replacement download, or another reasonable solution.

  • The supplied ZIP is corrupted or cannot be opened.
  • A listed file is missing from the delivered package.
  • The delivered design has a substantial technical defect that prevents normal use.
  • The wrong product was delivered.
  • An identical product was purchased twice and the duplicate can be verified.
  • The delivered product is materially different from the listing.

3. Contact Us About Technical Problems

If something is not working correctly, contact Craftshan Studio as soon as possible. Please provide your order number, product name, a short explanation of the problem, and—when useful—a screenshot or error message.

Where the issue appears to come from the supplied files, we will make reasonable efforts to correct or replace them before considering any other remedy.

4. Situations That Normally Do Not Qualify

A refund or replacement is normally not provided because:

  • You changed your mind or no longer want the design.
  • You purchased the wrong design and the listing was clear.
  • You expected a physical item instead of a digital file.
  • Your machine, operating system, or software is not compatible.
  • You are unsure how to use your cutting, engraving, or design software.
  • Your machine settings or materials produce an unexpected result.
  • You modified, converted, or resized the file incorrectly.
  • You found another design you prefer after purchasing.

5. Machine & Software Compatibility

Laser machines, cutting software, operating systems, materials, and workflows vary widely. Craftshan Studio provides the formats stated on the product page but cannot guarantee compatibility with every machine or software configuration.

Customers are responsible for checking the listed formats and confirming that they can use the files with their own setup before purchasing. We are happy to offer reasonable troubleshooting where possible.

6. Duplicate Purchases

If the exact same digital product is purchased twice by mistake, contact us promptly with the relevant order details. Once the duplicate transaction is verified, Craftshan Studio may provide an appropriate remedy for the duplicate purchase.

7. Refunds Do Not Transfer Digital Rights

If a refund is approved for a digital product, the associated license may be terminated. You must stop using the refunded design and delete the downloaded files unless Craftshan Studio confirms otherwise in writing.

A refund does not create a right to continue selling, producing, sharing, or distributing work based on the refunded digital design.

8. Abuse & Fraud

Craftshan Studio may decline requests that reasonably appear to involve repeated refund abuse, false technical claims, attempts to obtain files without payment, fraudulent chargebacks, or continued use of a product after a refund.

This does not limit any consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.

9. Payment Processing

When online payment processing is enabled, payments and any approved refunds may be handled through the payment provider connected to Craftshan Studio. Processing times can also depend on the provider, bank, card issuer, or other financial institution.

10. Chargebacks & Payment Disputes

If you believe there is a billing or delivery problem, please contact Craftshan Studio before starting a chargeback whenever reasonably possible. We will make reasonable efforts to investigate legitimate issues and provide an appropriate resolution.

11. Mandatory Consumer Rights

Nothing in this policy is intended to remove or restrict any consumer protection, cancellation right, refund right, replacement right, or other remedy that applicable law does not permit us to exclude.

12. Requesting Support

For a support request, use the Craftshan Studio contact page and include your order number, product name, and a clear description of the issue.

The Simple Rule

Digital purchase delivered → normally final.

Genuine file problem → contact us promptly so we can troubleshoot, replace, or correct the files where appropriate.

For genuine technical issues, please contact us within 3 calendar days of purchase where possible.

A purchase gives you the permissions described in the applicable Craftshan Studio Commercial License. It does not transfer copyright or ownership of the original digital design. The digital file itself may not be resold, shared, redistributed, uploaded, or included in another downloadable product unless written permission expressly allows it.

Please read the before using a design for commercial purposes.

6. Free Files

Free files are governed by the terms shown on their product page or the applicable free-file license. Unless a listing states otherwise, a free file should not be treated as automatically granting commercial resale rights.

7. Prices and Future Payments

Prices displayed on the website are those shown on the applicable product or plan page. Payment processing may be connected to a third-party provider in the future. Until a payment provider is enabled, checkout features may remain unavailable or display a connection notice.

8. Orders and Digital Delivery

When payments are enabled, successful orders may provide access to authorized digital downloads through the customer account. Download links may be protected, time-limited, or subject to account and purchase verification.

9. Refunds and Customer Support

Digital purchases are generally final because the products are delivered electronically. Limited remedies may apply to genuine delivery or technical problems as described in the .

For a file that is missing, corrupted, inaccessible, or materially different from its listing, contact Craftshan Studio promptly with your order details so the issue can be reviewed.

10. Prohibited Use

You may not use Craftshan Studio to:

  • Resell or redistribute digital files contrary to their license.
  • Claim Craftshan Studio designs as your own original digital work.
  • Upload purchased files to public or private downloadable libraries for others.
  • Use the website to attack, abuse, deceive, defraud, or interfere with other users or the service.
  • Attempt to bypass access controls or obtain unauthorized files.

11. Intellectual Property

Craftshan Studio's website branding, original written content, original product artwork, interface elements, and other protected materials remain the property of Craftshan Studio or the applicable rights holder unless stated otherwise. Your license gives only the rights expressly granted to you.

12. Website Availability

We aim to keep Craftshan Studio available and reliable, but we cannot promise uninterrupted access. Maintenance, hosting issues, security events, updates, or other circumstances may temporarily affect the website or downloads.

13. Product Compatibility

Laser machines, cutting software, materials, operating systems, and workflows differ. We make reasonable efforts to describe supported file formats accurately, but customers are responsible for confirming compatibility with their own equipment and software before purchasing.

14. Changes to the Store or These Terms

Craftshan Studio may update the website, products, prices, features, and these terms from time to time. The latest version published on the website will apply going forward, subject to applicable law and any rights already established by a completed purchase.

15. Contact

If you have a question about a product, purchase, license, account, or these terms, contact Craftshan Studio through the website contact page.

    Storefront Visibility

    The single place that decides which storefront sections customers can see. Saved in the database and applied to every visitor on every device.

    Storefront Visibility

    Show or hide storefront sections. ON = visible to customers, OFF = hidden. These switches save to the database immediately and apply to every visitor on every device. Hiding a section never deletes products, categories, reviews or tools.
